Exerscise: using functions
```{r}
print(round(3.14159))
```
```{r}
print(round(3.14159, digits=2))
```
```{r}
print(rep(5,7))
print(rep(x=5, times=7))
```
```{r}
x <- "character variable"
y <- 1
z <- TRUE

print(x)
print(class(x))
print(y)
print(class(y))
print(z)
print(class(z))
```
```{r}
cell_ID_1 <- "CX1"
cell_ID_2 <- "CX2"

treated_1 <- TRUE
treated_2 <- FALSE

num_before_1 <- 5415
num_before_2 <- 8123

num_after_1 <- 1432
num_after_2 <- 7543

ID_vec <- c(cell_ID_1, cell_ID_2)

treated_vec <- c(treated_1, treated_2)

num_before_vec <- c(num_before_1, num_before_2)

num_after_vec <- c(num_after_1, num_after_2)

all_my_pets <- c("dog", "horse", "guinea pig", "chicken", "cat")
new_name <- all_my_pets[4]
print(new_name)

x <- c(2, -4, 6, -2)
print(x*2)
print(x>5)
print(sum(x))
print(abs(x))

ex_data_frame <- tibble(
  cell_ID = ID_vec,
  treated = treated_vec,
  num_cells_before = num_before_vec,
  num_cells_after = num_after_vec
)

gt(ex_data_frame)


```
